story_title: Indian Grid Factor Mismatch in Scope 3 Balance Sheets
thesis: Most carbon accounting platforms in India default to global US/EU proxies for domestic manufacturing—distorting Scope 3 footprints by up to 38%.
selected_hook: If your carbon accounting software defaults 1 kWh of Indian industrial power to a global proxy, your Scope 3 balance sheet is wrong by 38% before you even audit transportation.
post_content: Gemini API text generation fallback active.
cta_question: If your Scope 3 calculations currently default to global databases for Indian supply chains, how are you validating grid uplift factors before filing your BRSR report?
